name: fpesa
description: Fpesa — live FX & gold trading platform for Kenya

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
